old_caption: The video showcases two tall palm trees adorned with colorful lights against a dark night sky. The left tree is illuminated with red lights, while the right tree is lit with blue lights. Both trees remain stationary throughout the sequence, with the camera focused on them. The background features a dark sky, which contrasts with the vibrant colors of the lights. The scene captures the illuminated trees.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases two tall palm trees adorned with colorful lights against a dark night sky. The left tree is illuminated with red and blue lights, while the right tree is lit with white and blue lights. Both trees sway gently, creating a dynamic visual effect. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the illuminated palms. The background features a dark, starless sky, which contrasts sharply with the vibrant colors of the lights. The scene captures the festive and lively atmosphere created by the twinkling lights, emphasizing the beauty and charm of the illuminated trees.
caption: The video showcases two stationary LED-wrapped palm trees glowing against a dark night background, with shrubbery below and a small plant at the right edge. A white chase climbs the left trunk while its fronds turn white with red edges. The right tree becomes solid blue. A thin red streak remains on the left trunk as the right tree stays blue. Red pixels spread across the right fronds and trunk, replacing the blue. A blue streak appears on the left trunk and fronds, while a white chase climbs the right trunk and fronds as only the lights change.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
